description: This file defines the S3SignatureV4 class which extends SignatureV4 to implement Amazon S3 specific signature version 4 signing logic, including request signing, presigning, and handling S3-specific headers.

classes.name: S3SignatureV4
classes.description: A class extending SignatureV4 to add S3-specific signing logic, supporting request signing, presigning, and custom path handling for Amazon S3.

methods.name: signRequest
methods.description: Signs an HTTP request for S3 with version 4 signature, adding necessary headers and handling different host cases.

methods.name: signWithV4a
methods.description: Performs signing using V4a (asymmetric) signatures with custom configuration for S3.

methods.name: presign
methods.description: Generates presigned URLs for S3 with added headers and special host handling.

methods.name: getPresignedPayload
methods.description: Returns an unsigned payload identifier for presigned URL generation.

methods.name: createCanonicalizedPath
methods.description: Creates a canonical path for signing that avoids double-encoding slashes in S3 object keys.
